claims.explanation: U-18666A is a lysosomotropic amphiphile that inhibits cholesterol egress from late endosomes/lysosomes, likely by interfering with NPC1 function, and also inhibits oxidosqualene cyclase. Cancer cells with high lysosomal/autophagic flux and dependence on cholesterol trafficking, such as those with RAS/MAPK pathway activation or loss of PTEN, may be more sensitive to this disruption. Conversely, cells with high cholesterol efflux capacity or low lysosomal demand may be protected.

ABCA1 mediates cholesterol efflux; high expression may reduce lysosomal cholesterol accumulation.
